name: Mesa Games
description: Uruguayan board game publisher selling its own modern board games online with add-to-cart. States shipping to the whole country, free above a stated amount.
description_es: Editorial uruguaya de juegos de mesa que vende sus propios juegos modernos online con carrito. Indica envíos a todo el país, gratis desde un monto indicado.

ships_to.notes: States free shipping nationwide above a stated amount; the homepage mentions 24 to 48 hours.

search.notes: Homepage returned 429; automated access looks restricted (challenge).

shopping_notes: Built on Wix Stores. The probe met a bot challenge, so automated access may be restricted. The catalogue lists about a dozen products. A points-of-sale page exists but pickup is not stated.

sources.supports: 12 products, add-to-cart, free nationwide shipping above a stated amount
